plan_a_advantages: Includes a dedicated tempo session for threshold strength.
Features two longer runs to build aerobic base.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated tempo session to build threshold strength, a crucial component for sustained speed on trails, while Plan B lacks this specific element. Furthermore, Plan A includes two longer runs, which are vital for building the aerobic base necessary for faster times, whereas Plan B’s long runs are shorter and focused more on endurance. Plan A’s structure also allows for more targeted training, addressing both aerobic capacity and strength, which is more aligned with the goal of improving speed.
